title: Pause Menu Tweaks
description: Adds settings to hide Buttons in the Pause Menu/Game Menu
body:
**This is a small Forge Mod for hiding/unhiding the pause menu buttons**

## Content
This mod offers you the following options, that you can change:
* **Hide Advancements Button** - Hides the Advancements button (useful when you have added a mod that allows showing advancements through an item)
* **Hide Statistics Button** - Hides the Statistics Button
* **Hide Open to LAN** - When on a Server, it hides that button entirely (but keeps it in Singleplayer)
* **Hide Mod Options** - turns off the Mod Options Button (primarily useful for Modpack makers)
* **Hide Extra Buttons** - If you want to hide additional buttons (like from Mods) you can just type in their translation keys here (that and the id are the only two identifiers for buttons, I chose the former)

## Incompatabilities
Any mod that replaces the Pause Menu with a custom one (that doesn't use the original Class or uses different button Text)
